text: Gaussian畳込みGSPHによるSod型粒子衝撃管 Sod-type particle shock tube with Gaussian-convolution GSPH Gaussian畳込みGSPHによるSod型粒子衝撃管 U_t+F(U)_x=0,\quad p=(\gamma-1)\rho e,\quad\gamma=1.4; V_{ij}^2(h)=\frac{h^2}{4}\left(\frac{V_i-V_j}{r_{ij}}\right)^2+\left(\frac{V_i+V_j}{2}\right)^2,\quad V_i=1/\rho_i,\quad h_i=\eta m_i/\rho_{\rm smooth,i} Gaussianの線形比体積GSPH重なり積分、対称な可変h、独立な対Riemann解、反対称な全エネルギー交換を実装します。通常SPHへの星状態圧力の代入とは区別。再構築は1次に限定し、原著の3次/MUSCL実装や一般的な高精度は主張しません。 Sod-type particle shock tube with Gaussian-convolution GSPH U_t+F(U)_x=0,\quad p=(\gamma-1)\rho e,\quad\gamma=1.4; V_{ij}^2(h)=\frac{h^2}{4}\left(\frac{V_i-V_j}{r_{ij}}\right)^2+\left(\frac{V_i+V_j}{2}\right)^2,\quad V_i=1/\rho_i,\quad h_i=\eta m_i/\rho_{\rm smooth,i} Actual Gaussian linear-specific-volume GSPH overlap with symmetric variable h, independent pair Riemann solves and antisymmetric total-energy exchange; not substitution of star pressure into ordinary SPH. First-order reconstruction only, not the paper cubic/MUSCL implementation or a general accuracy claim. gsph-sod Gaussian畳込みGSPHによるSod型粒子衝撃管 Sod-type particle shock tube with Gaussian-convolution GSPH 厳密解・参照解 参照解 reference solution 半解析解 Semi-analytic reference
